fieldValues.title: X1 remainder: per-concept type-table placement and pseudo-IDL drop
fieldValues.summary: The one clause of srs#787 ruling R1 that X1 (srs#801) could not complete within its Composition/View-only scope: each generated-type-reference's property table cannot be moved under its own type's concept, and the pseudo-IDL duplicate cannot be dropped, without either splitting generated-type-reference's content field (schema/generator change) or minting new per-type concept records to reparent under -- both record-content changes outside X1's file set. Needs an owner decision among the three paths srs#837 lays out before a unit can be shaped.
fieldValues.body: Filed by X1 (srs#801) as a parked finding rather than hand-hacked. Three paths named in srs#837: (1) split generated-type-reference's content into a table field and a pseudo-IDL field so a View's fieldViews[].visible can suppress the pseudo-IDL half -- Door 2/3, schema/generator work; (2) an owner ruling that the three umbrella Group concepts (Foundation Group (Core), Distribution Group (Core), the Extensions-part equivalent) already ARE each type's 'own concept' for R1's purpose, leaving only the pseudo-IDL drop, which still needs path (1)'s field split; (3) accept the pseudo-IDL block as presentation debt and rescope R1 down to a generator-only change, explicitly not non-normative/auto-mergeable. No P-unit in the Read as a human wave names this as a blocking dependency as written: P2 (Foundations) moved its own reference material (the valueType historical note) under Foundation Group (Core) without needing the table/pseudo-IDL split, and no other P-unit's body cites srs#837. Left with no depends-on edge for that reason; add one if a later P-unit's shaping finds it needs this first.
